progression.narrative: The performance opens on F4 and dwells most on G in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:07.5) introduces Ak, F, centred on Ak. Phrase 4 (0:51.7) introduces Gs, centred on G. The line peaks at Ak4 (445.1 Hz) at 0:28.3. It closes on F4, not the tonic (G4 → G4 → G4 → G4 → G4 → F4).
